headlines.title: Keurig Dr Pepper Announces Proposed Public Offering of Common Stock
headlines.line: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. has commenced an underwritten public offering of $2.0 billion of its common stock.

headlines.title: Takeda Launches ORZEYFUL™ (oveporexton) for Narcolepsy Type 1 in the United States
headlines.line: Takeda has announced the U.S. launch of ORZEYFUL™ (oveporexton), a new treatment for adults with narcolepsy type 1.

headlines.title: Aya Gold & Silver Reports Q3 2026 Financial and Operational Results
headlines.line: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. announced strong third-quarter 2026 results, featuring a 90% year-over-year revenue increase and a narrowed production guidance for its Zgounder silver mine.

headlines.title: Meta Expands Partnership with Nevoya for Electric Trucking
headlines.line: Meta has entered into a multi-year agreement with Nevoya to support the deployment of 25 battery-electric trucks on the I-10 corridor through the purchase of environmental attribute certificates.

headlines.title: Meta Fined by UK Regulator Over WhatsApp Business Data Inaccuracies
headlines.line: The UK's communications regulator, Ofcom, has fined Meta Platforms £596,700 for providing inaccurate information regarding its WhatsApp Business service.

headlines.title: Meta Signs Multi-Year Green Steel Agreement with Stegra
headlines.line: Meta has partnered with Stegra to purchase environmental attribute certificates linked to a green steel plant currently under construction in Northern Sweden.

summary:
**Market summary, session of 2026-11-11**

U.S. equities rose in the previous session. The Nasdaq 100 (QQQ) gained 2.31% and the S&P 500 (SPY) gained 1.32%, while the Dow (DIA) added 0.52% and the Russell 2000 (IWM) rose 0.89%. Technology led, with XLK up 3.23%. Energy (XLE, +1.86%) and industrials (XLI, +1.33%) also advanced. Consumer discretionary (XLY) was essentially flat. Gold (GLD) fell 1.13%, and the dollar (UUP) rose 0.69%. Oil (USO) was roughly unchanged on the day but is down 2.71% over five days.

Company news included Hancock Whitney's agreement to acquire Trustmark in an all-stock deal valued at about $3.2 billion, or $54.02 per share, with completion expected in late Q1 2027. Keurig Dr Pepper announced a proposed $2.0 billion common stock offering. Takeda launched ORZEYFUL in the U.S. IonQ shares were falling in pre-market trading amid quantum-sector weakness and a Rigetti earnings miss.

In politics, a headline reported that Trump said "we don't need a deal with Iran."
